title: [Decision] A restart puts seeded records back: a customer's edit to a seeded row is overwritten by the next boot
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

The maintainer: 「等我决定的都要立卡，并且从业务的角度给我具体解释和我沟通」 (2026-11-04). Measured by the seat on `main` `63b86b385d`, on the example CRM unless noted. No `domain:*` label is set: triage routes this card.

## The question

A package ships starter records with `mode: 'upsert'`, the spec's default. Each boot loads them again by `externalId`, so an edit a customer made to one of those rows goes back to the shipped value, silently. Is that what a seed should do once a customer owns the data?

Governing text: `packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts:170` (`mode` default `upsert`), `:205` (`env` default includes `prod`), `:61-62` (a column policy `create` writes a column only when the row is created). ADR-0131 ("declared is code, no seeding") covers metadata, not this business data.

## Measured

- On the CRM, `Acme — Q3 Platform Renewal`'s probability was edited to 75 in the running app and read 75.
- After restarting the dev backend it read 70, the seed's value, and `updated_at` was the boot time. A record not in the seed (`Eval Test Opp 1102`) kept its edit.
- Every seeded opportunity's `updated_at` moves at each boot, so 更新于 reads minutes ago on rows nobody touched.

This was measured on `objectstack dev` only. The seat did not measure a production `serve` boot or an upgrade, so whether a production customer loses edits this way is **unverified**. The `env` default and the replay comments suggest it can happen. Measure it first.

## Options

- **A. Create-only by default:** a replay inserts missing rows and leaves existing ones alone. An author who wants reset behaviour says so explicitly.
- **B. Keep upsert, change the examples:** examples use `ignore` or the column policy.
- **C. Keep as is,** and document it.

## Recommendation: measure production, then A

## 四轴分析

**实际业务需求。** 客户改了预置的客户、产品、配置类记录，升级或重启后被改回去，而且没有任何提示。这是最难被原谅的一类问题：数据悄悄丢了，往往很久才发现。

**项目长远合理性。** 种子是「开始用的初始数据」，一旦交给客户，数据就归客户。A 符合这个归属。B 只治示例，默认值还在坑人。

**防 AI 写错。** AI 写种子常按示例或默认值。A 让默认值是安全的；要覆盖时必须明说。

**创业阶段不扩散。** 这是修正默认行为，不是加能力。但它是破坏性的默认值变更，已发布的包如果依赖覆盖行为会受影响，要先量一下有没有这样的包。

| 棱 | A | B | C |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 业务 | 强 | 中 | 弱 |
| 长远 | 强 | 弱 | 弱 |
| 防错 | 强 | 中 | 弱 |
| 不扩散 | 中 | 强 | 强 |

## Re-check

`git grep -n "SeedMode.default('upsert')" origin/main -- packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts`
